verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents importing objects and vectors and configuring multi-node replication. It does not document upsert or delete operations, how quickly writes appear in search results, or any freshness or consistency behavior. Bulk import and replication factor are adjacent features, not evidence for this story, so the verdict is none even though the axis clearly applies to a vector database.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upsert and delete records continuously and have changes reflected in search results quickly, with documented freshness/consistency behavior
